question: Elon Musk # tweets October 9 - October 16, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from October 9 12:00 PM ET to October 16, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
I couldn't get a live count from the official tracker. The strongest signal is the week just before this one: the Oct 2-9 market was priced 100% at 320-339 posts, well above the 160-239 range of the previous five weeks.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding figure is the "Post Counter" for @elonmusk at xtracker.polymarket.com, for Oct 9 12:00 PM ET to Oct 16, 2026 12:00 PM ET. [xtracker](https://xtracker.polymarket.com)
- When fetched, the tracker page only showed "Loading users...", and its tracking list (the API) had empty count fields. So I could not get a live count for Oct 9-16. [xtracker API](https://xtracker.polymarket.com/api/users/elonmusk/trackings)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-10-10: The window is about one day in, out of seven. I found no count published on or before Oct 10, and nothing that settles the question.
- The aggregator page for this market had a snapshot dated after Oct 10. Per the rules I left it out.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-10 (snapshot 15:55 UTC): The Oct 2-9 weekly market was priced 100% at **320-339** posts, with $6.1M volume. That is a sharp jump from the weeks before. [PredScope](https://predscope.com/event/elon-musk-of-tweets-october-2-october-9-2026)
- 2026-10-08: A Catcher Predict note said the "280-299" bucket in the Oct 2-9 market jumped to about 17.95% that day and mentioned possible breaking news. It didn't say what the news was. So in its last day or two that week was running higher than traders expected. [RootData](https://www.rootdata.com/news/782226)
- 2026-10-08 (snapshot): The Oct 5-7 two-day market sat at 100% for 40-64 posts, a normal pace. So the burst seems to have come around Oct 7-9, just before this window opened. [PredScope](https://predscope.com/event/elon-musk-of-tweets-october-5-october-7-2026)
- I couldn't find a news story explaining the high posting around Oct 7-9. Context from the period: Musk is spending heavily on the 2026 midterms, which may drive political posting. [Yahoo](https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/republicans-win-midterms-elon-musk-080015951.html)

What these show:
- The typical week from September to early October was 160-239 posts, centred around 200-219, or about 29-31 posts a day.
- Most recent: the latest week (Oct 2-9) jumped to about 330, or roughly 47 posts a day.
- The table's buckets cover 180-319. Both the September low (160-179) and the latest week (320-339) would have fallen into "Other".
- Two-day markets in late September and early October mostly finished at 40-64 posts. [link](https://predscope.com/event/elon-musk-of-tweets-october-5-october-7-2026)

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-10-06 (snapshot, before the window opened): this Oct 9-16 market had about $11K volume and no clear favourite. 180-199 led at about 22%, with 200-219 close behind. That was before the Oct 7-9 burst showed up, so it's probably stale. [PredScope](https://predscope.com/event/elon-musk-of-tweets-october-9-october-16-2026)
- 2026-10-03 (snapshot): the overlapping Oct 6-13 market had 200-219 at about 24% and 180-199 at about 22%. [PredScope](https://predscope.com/event/elon-musk-of-tweets-october-6-october-13-2026)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold market on this exact question, and no Polymarket price for this market from Oct 9-10.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (Oct 16)
- The US midterms are on Nov 3, 2026, and Musk is heavily involved financially. Political posting is likely to stay high through the campaign. [Yahoo](https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/republicans-win-midterms-elon-musk-080015951.html)
- SpaceX's Q3 call (Oct 20) and Tesla's Q3 webcast (Oct 21) both come after this window closes.
- I found no specific scheduled event between Oct 9 and Oct 16. The main open question is whether the Oct 7-9 burst keeps going (pointing to 280-339 or above) or falls back to the usual September pace of 180-239.
